messages:
Marie: Quick sync — proposal to shrink the alpha scope so we can ship something reliable faster. Focus on 3 items: 1) eval-triggered alerts (webhook + runbook), 2) batching/caching recommendations (per-route heuristics), 3) quantization profiling + per-model suggestions. Customers (Acme, Nimbus) are asking for predictable SLA/rollback guidance. Thoughts?
Alex: +1 to narrowing. Shipping fewer solid features > lots of half-baked pieces. Note: batching heuristics need to be reversible (don’t break tail latency).
Diego: We can do quant profiling offline and expose a graded suggestion (e.g., safe, experimental). For alpha, recommend we ship 'insights' + estimated quality delta instead of auto-apply.
Sara: From cust side — webhook for alerts + one-click sample rollback steps is table stakes. Also want evals to run against customer-like prompt sets, otherwise alerts are noisy.
Jen: Concrete launch gates proposal:
- alert delivery and webhook reliability tested end-to-end (SLA: 99% delivery)
- eval-alert false positive rate <5% on pilot prompt sets
- batching recs do not increase p99 latency by >5% in pilot
- docs + sample config for customers and SEs
If any of the above fail, label as beta and delay GA.
Alex: I can take batching + caching heuristics. Plan: produce a small API that returns suggested max_batch_size and cacheable_prefixes per route. Add a dry-run mode so customers can simulate before applying.
Diego: I’ll prototype quant sweeps. Need an infra slot for ~200 model runs (low fidelity) — can we get a Dedicated pool for the prototype?
Marie: @Jen capture infra ask and prioritization for next planning. Also agree on dry-run mode — great idea, @Alex.
deploy-bot: Created branch optimize/alpha-scope-shrink and milestone 'alpha-minimal'
Jen: Acceptance criteria we should track in the milestone: runbook + playbooks, pilot run with Acme, telemetry (SLIs for alert latency, false positives, batching regressions). Also add retention/GDPR checks for eval data.
Sara: I'll prep a customer prompt pack and SE playbook for rollback steps. Can we include a sample webhook body?
Alex: sample webhook payload: ```{
  "alert_id": "uuid",
  "model": "gptx-8k",
  "metric": "concordance_drop",
  "value": 0.12,
  "suggested_action": "switch-to-quant-safe"
}```
Marie: Timeline suggestion: 2 sprints for prototype quant insights, 3 sprints for eval-alert webhooks + dry-run batching, 4th sprint pilot with Acme. If infra not available, we push pilot by 1 sprint.
Diego: Quick note — quant profiling results should include confidence bands and example prompt regressions to help SEs triage.
Jen: Ok I'll add the gating checklist to the milestone and ping legal on retention.
Marie: Thanks — I'll run this at the roadmap huddle tomorrow. If no major objections, we'll lock alpha scope to this and call out remaining items for beta. :thumbsup:
Alex: 👍
